sentences.en: A mathematical truth is neither simple nor complicated; it is.
sentences.zh: 数学真理既不是简单的也不是复杂的；它就是它。

sentences.en: The story was so complicated that I couldn't follow it.
sentences.zh: 这个故事太复杂了，我都听不懂。

sentences.en: The writing style is much less complicated in this article.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章的写作风格在这部分要简单得多。

senses.zh: hard to understand, explain, or deal with 复杂难懂的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：com（共同）+plic（重叠）+ ated→重叠在一起的→复杂的
